name: KitchenOwl
tagline: Self-hosted grocery list and recipe manager
description: KitchenOwl is a self-hosted grocery list and recipe manager. Track what you need to buy, add recipes, plan meals, and sync your household shopping lists across all your devices in real time.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Jwt secret key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  app:
    container_name: big-bear-kitchenowl
    image: tombursch/kitchenowl:v0.7.10@sha256:bd821a41b8cb27fd7fcf429acd1fc67e9f889485a2cd1193d68c2d804a8e1bef
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
    environment:
      - JWT_SECRET_KEY=${SECRET_JWT_SECRET_KEY}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/data
notes: Create your account on first launch, then share the household list by inviting members from the settings.
